meta.title: Download — PreFrame
meta.description: PreFrame for macOS is in signing and notarization. Nothing to download yet — here's exactly where the build stands.
meta.ogDescription: PreFrame for macOS is in signing and notarization. Nothing to download yet.

head.title: Not ready yet — and I'd rather say so.
head.lede: The macOS build exists and works. What it doesn't have yet is Apple's signature and notarization, and shipping an unsigned app that macOS refuses to open is a worse first impression than waiting. This page is where it lands the day it's ready.

mac.title: In notarization
mac.body: Apple Developer enrollment, code signing and notarization. Until that's done there is no download link here — not a beta, not a workaround.

windows.title: No date
windows.body: There's no Windows build and no timeline for one. No waitlist either: a form that collects emails for something with no date is just a form.
windows.req: Check back, or watch the release notes.

cards.title: The full app
cards.body: Not a trial build. Your first project is free and complete, with its substrate and its exports.

cards.title: Signed and notarized
cards.body: It opens the way any Mac app opens: double-click, no right-click workaround, no scary dialog.

cards.title: Auto-update
cards.body: New versions arrive in the app. Every one of them is written up in the release notes.

cards.title: Offline by default
cards.body: Your audio and images stay on your machine. You can work with no connection at all.
